label: EWSR1::NFATC2

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
NFATC2 encodes a calcium/calcineurin-responsive transcription factor.

The fusion joins the EWSR1 activation region to NFATC2 DNA-binding sequences. It identifies a molecularly distinct EWSR1::non-ETS sarcoma, often arising in long bones, rather than conventional Ewing sarcoma.
